items.title: Why Is Diamondback (FANG) Up 5.9% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.summary: Diamondback (FANG) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: ONEOK to Buy Brazos Midstream’s Permian Assets for $4.43 Billion
items.summary: ONEOK is set to acquire Brazos Midstream’s Permian Midland Basin natural gas gathering and processing assets for $4.43 billion, expanding its footprint in prolific American oil hub.

items.title: ‘Soap Cocktails’ Help U.S. Shale Boost Oil Production
items.summary: U.S. shale producers are increasingly using advanced chemical surfactants to release more oil from tight rock and boost recovery from existing wells.

items.title: Oil Remains Above $80: Are Permian Stocks Well Poised to Gain?
items.summary: Oil above $80 and rising Permian output could support Diamondback Energy, ExxonMobil and Chevron as Middle East tensions keep crude prices elevated.

items.title: Analysts' Top S&P 500 Stocks to Buy Now
items.summary: Wynn Resorts, AutoZone and Diamondback Energy make Wall Street's list of top-rated stocks this month. Some of the other names might surprise you.

items.title: Energy CEO Sells 10,000 Shares, Valued at $2.1 Million, Following 53% Rally
items.summary: Matthew Kaes Van'T Hof reduced his direct equity stake by 8% following a 53% one-year stock surge, retaining ~116,000 shares worth $24.47 million.

items.title: Occidental Petroleum Stock Can Climb Without A Higher Oil Price
items.summary: Management's own plan leans on lower costs, a slower decline rate, and a stronger balance sheet, not on the price of crude.

items.title: Diamondback Hits a Milestone at Just the Right Time
items.summary: Diamondback Energy topped 1 million BOE/d, posted record quarterly revenue and earnings, raised guidance, and doubled its buyback, while analysts maintain a consensus Buy rating.
